# Chronic Hypertension 
SBP > 140/90 before conception or <20 weeks.

# Gestational Hypertension 
New SBP > 140/90 at >20 weeks 
No proteinuria or organ damage 

# [[Preeclampsia]]
New SBP > 140/90 at >20 weeks and 
Proteinuria or organ damage 

# Eclampsia 
Preeclampsia and tonic-clonic seizures 

# Complications 
- Fetal growth restriction due to vasoconstriction 
- Fetal demise 
- Placental abruption
- [[Postpartum Hemorrhage]]
- Preterm delivery
